text:
Lena Ortiz: Quick flag for QBR packet: NebulaWorks (SI) asking for a one-time MDF top-up for integration sprint (~$32k) so they can finish the connector before our joint launch. Also SkyLaunch (marketplace) requests extending the announcement runway from 4->7 weeks to coordinate cloud-tile testing.
Marcus Li: Numbers please. Is the $32k all spend or includes credits? Need breakout.
Lena Ortiz: Breakdown: $20k engineering hours, $6k test infra credits, $4k co-marketing support (webinar/ads), $2k contingency. Net request $32k.
Tasha Kim: Marketing: 7 weeks ok but we need assets locked by week 5 and final approvals by week 2 before publish. We can't do creative last-minute. Also a marketplace tile credit of $8k is requested by SkyLaunch?
Lena Ortiz: Yes, SkyLaunch asked for $8k tile credit but said it'd be offset by featured placement. They want toggle control for the tile during canary.
Owen Hart: Product: any dependencies on feature flags? If the tile depends on a beta API we need a rollback plan.
Lena Ortiz: NebulaWorks uses our public connector; no beta APIs. SkyLaunch integration uses a new auth flow but product confirmed can gate via feature flag.
ops-bot: Policy note: "MDF exceptions >$30k require Head of Partnerships + Finance approval and must include a measurable milestone. Announcement runway extensions >6 weeks need Marketing consent." (https://redwood.company/policies/partnerships-mdf)
Marcus Li: Since the MDF hits $32k, this crosses the >$30k rule. I need a one-page ask showing KPIs (demo conversions, pipeline $), timeline, and a post-launch measurement plan. Finance will give a prelim yes/no in 48h.
Tasha Kim: I'll need the marketing assets list and a proposed schedule. Quick checklist I can work from:
```
- Wk -7: NDA + draft blog outline
- Wk -5: Creative handoff + marketplace tile prototype
- Wk -3: Internal QA + legal review
- Day 0: Publish + joint webinar
- Wk +2: Lead routing & ABM followup
```
Lena Ortiz: I'll assemble the 1-pager and attach the partner scorecard. NebulaWorks current tier: Partner Bronze (revenue trailing for Tier2), but SI has strong technical momentum. Requesting waiver to approve as a strategic retention play.
Owen Hart: Suggest adding rollback controls: disable marketplace tile and pause paid promo; also ensure the connector has telemetry hooks.
Marcus Li: Agreed. Send the doc and tag me. If the ask creeps above $50k we'll need exec sales approval.
Lena Ortiz: Will post the doc in this thread by EOD. Thanks all. :pray:
